articles.title_en: Matching and price competition in large markets
articles.title_cn: 大市场中的匹配与价格竞争
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the large market implications of impersonal wage competition. There are finitely many categories of firms and workers, and firms compete for workers by offering uniform wages. We first characterize the unique mixed strategy Nash equilibrium of large replica economies with supermodular preferences. Competition is local: firms only compete with others like themselves, either within the same category or one category above. As the market size grows, the equilibrium converges rapidly to the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. For general preferences, Nash equilibria converge to competitive equilibria as the market becomes arbitrarily large. We identify a condition on preferences which ensures that the limiting equilibria differ from the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. Our analysis highlights how the interaction between preference structure and pricing flexibility governs whether uniform wage posting leads to suppressed or inflated wages in large markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究非人格化工资竞争在大市场中的含义。存在有限类别的企业和工人，企业通过提供统一工资来竞争工人。我们首先刻画了具有超模偏好的大型复制经济中唯一的混合策略纳什均衡。竞争是局部的：企业只与和自己类似的其他企业竞争，要么在同一类别内，要么在高于自己一个类别的范围内。随着市场规模增长，均衡迅速收敛到企业最优竞争均衡。对于一般偏好，当市场变得任意大时，纳什均衡收敛到竞争均衡。我们识别出一个关于偏好的条件，该条件确保极限均衡不同于企业最优竞争均衡。我们的分析凸显了偏好结构与定价灵活性之间的相互作用如何决定统一工资发布在大市场中导致工资被抑制还是被抬高。

articles.title_en: Are rich people smarter? A comment
articles.title_cn: 富人更聪明吗？一篇评论
articles.abstract_en: Levy (2003) studies a multiplicative wealth accumulation process under homogeneous investment talent and claims convergence to a stationary Pareto distribution. This comment shows that the result does not hold as stated. The relevant log-drift criterion implies that the process diverges almost surely when the log-drift is positive. When the log-drift is negative, any stationary distribution, if it exists, necessarily has infinite moments of all orders, implying empirically implausible tail behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: Levy（2003）在投资才能同质的假设下研究了一个乘法财富积累过程，并声称其收敛于一个平稳的帕累托分布。本评论表明，该结果按所述方式并不成立。相关的对数漂移准则意味着，当对数漂移为正时，该过程几乎必然发散。当对数漂移为负时，任何平稳分布（若存在）必然具有所有阶的无穷矩，这意味着在经验上不合理的尾部行为。

articles.abstract_en: Ex post strategy-proofness (ESP) extends the concept of strategy-proofness to settings with interdependent values. ESP requires that truthful reporting is always optimal for every agent, regardless of the strategies and types of other agents. We characterize the class of social choice functions implementable by ESP mechanisms with transfers. For a broad class of environments, including single-good auctions, implementability is jointly characterized by two conditions: (1) monotonicity, requiring that “higher” types induce “higher” alternatives; and (2) screenability, requiring that “entangled” types induce alternatives that are payoff-equivalent for the agent, where entanglement becomes increasingly restrictive as types become denser or preference interdependence strengthens. For general settings, we establish that implementability is equivalent to a generalized cyclical monotonicity condition, or equivalently, to an optimality condition derived from an induced matching problem between types and alternatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 事后策略防伪性（ESP）将策略防伪性的概念扩展到具有相互依存价值的环境。ESP要求真实报告对每个代理人始终是最优的，无论其他代理人的策略和类型如何。我们刻画了可通过带转移的ESP机制实施的社会选择函数类。对于广泛的环境类，包括单一物品拍卖，可实施性由两个条件共同刻画：（1）单调性，要求“更高”类型诱导“更高”备选方案；以及（2）可筛选性，要求“纠缠”类型诱导对代理人而言收益等价的备选方案，其中纠缠随着类型变得更密集或偏好相互依存增强而变得越来越具有限制性。对于一般设定，我们确立可实施性等价于广义循环单调性条件，或等价地，等价于由类型与备选方案之间诱导的匹配问题推导出的最优性条件。

articles.title_en: Price information and cost uncertainty in oligopoly
articles.title_cn: 寡头垄断中的价格信息与成本不确定性
articles.abstract_en: How do sellers compete when they are uncertain about rivals’ costs and consumers have limited price information? We introduce cost uncertainty into a canonical model of oligopoly (Burdett and Judd, 1983). Equilibrium prices respond heterogeneously to price information. When captive consumers become sufficiently more informed, all sellers lower prices. When non-captive consumers become sufficiently more informed, low-cost sellers cut prices, while high-cost sellers raise them. With consumer search, seller entry has no effect on prices when search costs are high but induces price divergence when they are low. More information, whether exogenous or search-induced, weakly improves expected total welfare, although it may harm captive consumers. Under price discrimination, aggregate consumer surplus is the same as under uniform pricing: gains for informed consumers exactly offset losses for captive consumers.
articles.abstract_cn: 当卖方对竞争对手的成本不确定且消费者的价格信息有限时，卖方如何竞争？我们将成本不确定性引入一个经典的寡头垄断模型（Burdett and Judd, 1983）。均衡价格对价格信息作出异质性反应。当受俘消费者变得信息足够充分时，所有卖方都降低价格。当非受俘消费者变得信息足够充分时，低成本卖方降价，而高成本卖方提价。在消费者搜索的情况下，当搜索成本高时，卖方进入对价格没有影响，但当搜索成本低时，会引发价格分化。更多信息，无论是外生的还是搜索引致的，都弱改善预期总福利，尽管可能损害受俘消费者。在价格歧视下，总消费者剩余与统一定价下相同：知情消费者的所得恰好抵消受俘消费者的所失。

articles.title_en: Rank dependent weighted average utility models for decision-making under objective ambiguity
articles.title_cn: 目标模糊下决策的秩依赖加权平均效用模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides an axiomatic characterization of a family of rank-dependent weighted average utility criteria for comparing finite sets of objective probability distributions over consequences. These sets are interpreted as objectively ambiguous prospects: the relevant probability distributions are part of the description of the alternative, but no likelihood is assigned to any of them. The resulting criteria evaluate a prospect by applying a utility function to each of its elements and taking a weighted average of the resulting utilities, where the weights depend on the rank of each element within the prospect. The main theorem characterizes the subclass of such criteria whose rank-dependent weights are generated by a single weighting function on the unit interval. A second characterization covers the larger family in which the weights may vary freely with the number of elements in the prospect. The paper also examines how comparative ambiguity aversion constrains utility functions and rank-dependent weights, and relates optimism and pessimism to the monotonicity of these weights.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为一类秩依赖加权平均效用准则提供了公理化刻画，这些准则用于比较后果上的有限目标概率分布集合。这些集合被解释为目标模糊前景：相关概率分布是备选方案描述的一部分，但未对其中任何一个赋予似然。由此产生的准则通过对其每个元素应用效用函数并对所得效用取加权平均来评估前景，其中权重取决于每个元素在前景中的秩。主要定理刻画了此类准则的子类，其秩依赖权重由单位区间上的单一加权函数生成。第二个刻画涵盖了更大的族，其中权重可随前景中元素数量自由变化。本文还考察了比较模糊厌恶如何约束效用函数和秩依赖权重，并将乐观与悲观同这些权重的单调性联系起来。

articles.title_en: Topology-free constructions of a universal type space as coherent belief hierarchies
articles.title_cn: 作为一致信念层级的普适类型空间的无拓扑构造
articles.abstract_en: This paper constructs a universal type space on an arbitrary measurable space of states of nature, without any topological assumption. The construction is explicit: the universal type space is the set of belief hierarchies that satisfy a coherency condition. This condition is stronger than the standard one. It requires a belief hierarchy (consisting of finite-order beliefs) to extend to all countable orders of beliefs, with no two orders in conflict. A topological assumption delivers such an extension automatically, and without one, the extension may fail. Under the stronger coherency condition, the universal type space also coincides with the implicit construction: the set of belief hierarchies induced by some type in some type space. Hence, the stronger coherency condition unifies the two known constructions. Finally, the need to track countable orders of beliefs has a game-theoretic counterpart: iterated elimination of strictly dominated actions may take transfinitely many rounds.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在任意可测的自然状态空间上构造了一个普适类型空间，无需任何拓扑假设。该构造是显式的：普适类型空间是满足一致性条件的信念层级的集合。该条件强于标准条件。它要求一个信念层级（由有限阶信念组成）可扩展至所有可数阶信念，且任意两个阶之间不存在冲突。拓扑假设会自动给出这样的扩展，而在没有拓扑假设时，该扩展可能失败。在更强的一致性条件下，普适类型空间也与隐式构造相一致：即由某个类型空间中的某个类型所诱导的信念层级的集合。因此，更强的一致性条件统一了两种已知的构造。最后，追踪可数阶信念的必要性有一个博弈论上的对应物：严格占优行动的迭代剔除可能需要超限多轮。

articles.abstract_en: Gul and Pesendorfer’s expected uncertain utility (EUU) theory describes a decision-maker who assigns probabilities to some events, regards others as unquantifiable, and values a prospect by a probability-weighted average of a utility of the best and worst outcomes it may yield on each quantifiable event. I extend EUU to dynamic settings where information arrives before an act is chosen. Outside subjective expected utility, three natural requirements cannot generally coexist: an act’s value should not depend on how the resolution of uncertainty is described; choices after a signal should depend only on what remains possible; and optimizing at each realization should yield a plan that is optimal in advance. The recursive extension characterized here secures the last two by associating with every signal, ambiguous or not, a unique system of conditional beliefs, while retaining EUU’s treatment of risk and ambiguity. For unambiguous signals it reduces to static EUU; otherwise an act’s value depends on how information is revealed. A tractable subclass accommodates choice patterns, such as Machina’s reflection example, that many ambiguity models cannot.
articles.abstract_cn: Gul和Pesendorfer的期望不确定效用（EUU）理论描述了一个决策者：她对某些事件赋予概率，将其他事件视为不可量化，并通过对每个可量化事件上可能产生的最好和最坏结果的效用进行概率加权平均来评估一个前景。我将EUU扩展到在行动被选择之前信息到达的动态环境。在主观期望效用之外，三个自然要求通常不能共存：一个行动的价值不应取决于不确定性的解决方式如何被描述；信号之后的选择应仅取决于仍然可能的情况；在每个实现处优化应产生一个事先最优的计划。这里刻画的递归扩展通过为每个信号（无论模糊与否）关联一个唯一的条件信念系统，确保了后两个要求，同时保留了EUU对风险和模糊的处理。对于明确信号，它退化为静态EUU；否则一个行动的价值取决于信息如何被揭示。一个可处理的子类容纳了许多模糊模型无法容纳的选择模式，例如Machina的反射例子。

articles.title_en: Optimal tax under dispersed and distorted beliefs
articles.title_cn: 分散且扭曲信念下的最优税收
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal corrective taxation in a large economy where the aggregate action imposes a negative externality. Agents observe a public signal, which the planner also sees, and private signals, which neither the planner nor other agents see. Agents overreact to both by overestimating their precision. The optimal tax closes the gap between equilibrium and the social optimum, and decomposes into the tax rule that would be optimal under rational expectations and a behavioral adjustment. Conventional wisdom, derived from common-belief models, holds that the adjustment should make the tax more sensitive to the public signal. But that logic assumes agents act only on what the planner observes. Once beliefs are dispersed, the adjustment must instead work through the realized aggregate action, and its direct response to the public signal reverses sign.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个大型经济体中的最优矫正性税收，其中加总行动产生负外部性。代理人观察到公共信号（规划者也观察到）和私人信号（规划者和其他代理人均未观察到）。代理人对两者都反应过度，高估其精度。最优税收弥合均衡与社会最优之间的差距，并分解为理性预期下最优的税收规则和一项行为调整。源自共同信念模型的传统观点认为，该调整应使税收对公共信号更敏感。但该逻辑假设代理人仅依据规划者所观察到的信息行动。一旦信念分散，调整就必须转而通过已实现的加总行动发挥作用，且其对公共信号的直接反应符号反转。

articles.title_en: Spatial protection spillovers and the equilibrium of crime and policing
articles.title_cn: 空间保护溢出与犯罪和警务的均衡
articles.abstract_en: Spatial heterogeneity in crime suggests that location is a key choice variable in criminal behavior and police allocation. To capture this, we develop a topological model in which criminals and the police interact strategically across space. The key departure from the existing literature is that distance matters: the coverage radius of a police unit generates spatial spillovers, so a location can receive protection from nearby patrols. This is in sharp contrast with discrete spatial models, where each cell is isolated from its surroundings, biasing the equilibrium police allocation and overlooking a form of the ecological fallacy. We analytically characterize this bias and, more generally, demonstrate how spillovers affect the equilibrium police allocation. In particular, as spillovers increase: (i) more (fewer) units are allocated at local maxima (minima) of crime; (ii) the location where units are more concentrated shifts toward the steepest side of the crime distribution; and (iii) the entropy of the police spatial density decreases. Jointly, our results point to the essential role of spatial spillovers in the equilibrium determination of crime and police allocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 犯罪的空间异质性表明，位置是犯罪行为和警力配置中的关键选择变量。为捕捉这一点，我们构建了一个拓扑模型，其中犯罪分子与警察在空间上策略性互动。与现有文献的关键区别在于距离起作用：一个警察单位的覆盖半径产生空间溢出，因此一个地点可以从附近巡逻中获得保护。这与离散空间模型形成鲜明对比，在离散空间模型中，每个单元与周围环境隔离，从而扭曲均衡警力配置并忽视一种生态谬误。我们解析地刻画了这种偏差，并更一般地证明了溢出如何影响均衡警力配置。特别地，随着溢出增加：(i) 更多（更少）单位被配置在犯罪的局部最大值（最小值）处；(ii) 单位更集中的位置向犯罪分布最陡的一侧移动；(iii) 警察空间密度的熵下降。综合来看，我们的结果指向空间溢出在犯罪和警力配置的均衡决定中的核心作用。

articles.title_cn: 重复互动中的信息设计
articles.abstract_en: How does a long-term relationship affect communication among economic entities? In this paper, we study dynamic information design in a simple “agreement game” with repeated interaction, where the state is imperfectly persistent. Disclosing information now influences future belief evolution, which results in a novel distortion relative to the static counterpart. We observe that the interaction of the players’ patience and the state’s persistence parameters is crucial in determining the optimal mechanism. Though an efficient mechanism is optimal with sufficiently small or large patience, with intermediate levels of patience, optimal mechanisms exhibit excessive agreement when states are sufficiently persistent, while they exhibit excessive disagreement with less persistence.
articles.abstract_cn: 长期关系如何影响经济主体之间的沟通？本文研究一个具有重复互动的简单“协议博弈”中的动态信息设计，其中状态是不完全持久的。现在披露信息会影响未来信念的演化，这相对于静态对应情形导致了一种新颖的扭曲。我们观察到，参与者的耐心与状态的持久性参数的交互作用在决定最优机制方面至关重要。尽管在耐心足够小或足够大时有效机制是最优的，但在中等耐心水平下，当状态足够持久时，最优机制表现出过度协议，而当持久性较低时，它们表现出过度分歧。

articles.title_en: Competitive search with repeated moral hazard
articles.title_cn: 重复道德风险下的竞争性搜索
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of moral hazard on employment and wage dynamics in a continuous-time competitive search model. Unobservable idiosyncratic factors require employers to design dynamic contracts to incentivize workers to exert effort. A higher level of public aggregate productivity reduces the relative importance of unobservable idiosyncratic factors, which facilitates the detection of shirking and relaxes firms’ incentive constraint. This channel amplifies the elasticity of vacancy to changes in aggregate productivity and induces time-varying schemes in wage compensation. When the informational friction is disciplined by the moment on individual workers’ wage residuals in PSID, the model produces higher unemployment volatility than that without the moral hazard problem. In addition, the model generates endogenous counter-cyclical wage dispersion.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究在连续时间竞争性搜索模型中道德风险对就业和工资动态的影响。不可观测的异质性因素要求雇主设计动态合约以激励工人付出努力。较高的公共总量生产率降低了不可观测异质性因素的相对重要性，这有助于检测偷懒并放松企业的激励约束。这一渠道放大了空缺对总量生产率变化的弹性，并引致工资补偿中的时变方案。当信息摩擦由PSID中个体工人工资残差的矩来约束时，该模型产生的失业波动性高于不存在道德风险问题的模型。此外，该模型生成了内生的逆周期性工资分散。

articles.abstract_en: We study a bilateral trade setting where a seller privately chooses quality, and a buyer may pay to verify it. We show that information acquisition by the buyer can give rise to an informational hold-up problem: when verification produces precise information, the seller shades quality, stripping the marginal buyer of surplus, causing trade to unravel. Trade survives only when verification is noisy enough to leave the buyer with residual surplus, yet precise enough to discipline the seller. The hold-up mechanism persists under buyer heterogeneity, noise in production, convex costs, and endogenous pricing.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个双边贸易环境，其中卖方私下选择质量，买方可能付费验证质量。我们表明，买方的信息获取可能引发信息套牢问题：当验证产生精确信息时，卖方会降低质量，剥夺边际买方的剩余，导致贸易瓦解。只有当验证噪声足够大以给买方留下剩余、同时又足够精确以约束卖方时，贸易才得以存续。该套牢机制在买方异质性、生产噪声、凸成本和内生定价下依然存在。

articles.title_en: Credit, privacy, and data monetization by digital platforms
articles.title_cn: 信贷、隐私与数字平台的数据变现
articles.abstract_en: Digital platforms collect extensive personal information from users while often also providing credit services. We study the interaction between data use and credit provision. Data use creates incentives for a monopolistic platform to subsidize credit, enabling it to compete with traditional financial institutions even when it faces higher costs. Credit services allow the platform to manipulate buyers’ outside options, extract greater surplus, and raise the value of using data. This may lead to socially inefficient outcomes. When platform competition is considered, platforms may specialize, with some focusing on data use and others on privacy. When credit provision is possible, the set of parameters under which platforms use buyers’ data expands. Finally, under certain conditions, a platform monetizes its data by selling it to a platform that specializes solely in credit services.
articles.abstract_cn: 数字平台从用户处收集大量个人信息，同时往往还提供信贷服务。我们研究数据使用与信贷提供之间的相互作用。数据使用为垄断性平台补贴信贷创造了激励，使其即使在面临更高成本时也能与传统金融机构竞争。信贷服务使平台能够操纵买方的外部选项、攫取更多剩余并提高使用数据的价值。这可能导致社会无效率的结果。当考虑平台竞争时，平台可能专业化，一些专注于数据使用，另一些专注于隐私。当信贷提供成为可能时，平台使用买方数据的参数集合扩大。最后，在某些条件下，平台通过将数据出售给专门从事信贷服务的平台来实现数据变现。

articles.title_cn: 策略性无知与信息设计
articles.abstract_en: We study information design in strategic settings when agents can publicly refuse to view their private signals. Ignoring the constraints that agents must be willing to view their signals may lead to substantial divergence between the designer’s intent and actual outcomes, even in the case where the designer seeks to maximize the agents’ payoffs. We introduce the appropriate equilibrium concept — ignorance-permissive Bayes correlated equilibrium — and characterize implementable distributions over states and actions. The designer’s optimal response to strategic ignorance generates qualitative properties that standard information design cannot: the designer may provide redundant or even counterproductive information, asymmetric information structures may be strictly optimal in symmetric environments, providing information conditional on players’ viewing choices rather than all at once may hurt the designer, and communication between players may help her. Optimality sometimes requires that players ignore their signals with positive probability.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究当代理人可以公开拒绝查看其私人信号时的策略性环境中的信息设计。忽视代理人必须愿意查看其信号的约束，可能导致设计者的意图与实际结果之间出现重大偏离，即使在设计者寻求最大化代理人收益的情况下也是如此。我们引入适当均衡概念——允许无知的贝叶斯相关均衡——并刻画可实施的状态与行动分布。设计者对策略性无知的最优反应产生了标准信息设计无法产生的定性性质：设计者可能提供冗余甚至适得其反的信息，不对称信息结构在对称环境中可能严格最优，以玩家的查看选择为条件而非一次性提供信息可能损害设计者，玩家之间的沟通可能对她有帮助。最优性有时要求玩家以正概率忽略其信号。

articles.title_cn: 内生收入下的减贫税收
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops nonlinear income tax systems designed to reduce poverty within a framework where income is endogenously determined. Our approach to poverty reduction is applicable across a wide range of poverty measures and remains robust under varying economic conditions, including heterogeneous wage distributions, non-labor endowments, and diverse individual preferences. When negative marginal tax rates are deemed infeasible—potentially due to concerns about vertical equity—a poverty-reducing schedule must provide a uniform lump-sum subsidy across the range where net income can remain weakly below the poverty line. Even when negative marginal tax rates are permissible, effective poverty-reducing tax policies must still rely on subsidization for the poor and non-positive marginal tax rates as essential features.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在内生决定收入的框架下，构建了旨在减少贫困的非线性所得税体系。我们的减贫方法适用于广泛的贫困度量指标，并且在各种经济条件下保持稳健，包括异质性工资分布、非劳动禀赋以及多样化的个人偏好。当负边际税率被认为不可行时——可能是出于对纵向公平的担忧——减贫税制必须在净收入可能弱低于贫困线的范围内提供统一的定额补贴。即使负边际税率被允许，有效的减贫税收政策仍必须依赖对穷人的补贴以及非正边际税率作为基本特征。
